source: Wang et al. 2025, Scientific Reports 15, Figure 3: Time-calibrated sauropodomorph tree, thin lines, coloured range bars, 69 tips; several polytomies (a 6-way basal node, a 7-way node with Jaklapallisaurus to Nambalia, a 7-way node in Sauropodiformes, a 3-way Gongxianosaurus/Ingentia node). Image: embedded image at native resolution, unmodified (1776x2363 px). Gold tree and name list from the Open Paleo corpus session (2026-10-29).
